notes: JSONL input is the uncompressed append-only ingestion artifact that produced this snapshot.
Parquet files are Zstandard-compressed shards with dictionary encoding.
Parquet page uncompressed bytes are the decoded Arrow/Parquet column pages, not the JSONL source.

raw_uspto_archives_claim.reason: Completed archives are deleted after ingest; bulkdata.uspto.gov is not required to size the published snapshot.
raw_uspto_archives_claim.statement: Project documentation describes official weekly USPTO ZIP archives on the order of 1.6 TB before deletion.
